sentences.text:
THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 09.10.2024, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2024:KER:75955 WP(C)No.34137 of 2024  2  JUDGMENT Dated this the 9th day of October, 2024
This writ petition is filed seeking adequate police protection to the petitioner and his family from the threat of the 3rd respondent.
Admittedly, a dispute is pending between the petitioner and the 3 rd respondent in connection with the leasing out of the petitioner's vehicle to the 3rd respondent.
The petitioner alleges that the 3 rd respondent is using the vehicle for nefarious activities, including transportation of contraband.
Heard, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that, after misusing the vehicle, the 3 rd respondent left the car in a garage and the petitioner had to expend more than Rs.1,25,000/- for making the car roadworthy.
4. Learned Government Pleader submits that the petitioner is involved in eight crimes across the State, alleging commission of offences under Sections 420 and 406 of IPC.
5. Indisputably, the petitioner was prompted to approach this Court by reason of a monetary dispute.
It has also come out that the petitioner is involved in various crimes.

In such circumstances,
no order of police protection can be granted.
The writ petition is hence closed, reserving the petitioner's liberty to seek remedies before the appropriate forum/court.

Sd/-
